# Released lens fixture

`lens-export.json` was generated by `zard-doc build --format json --lens-root …`
using Rigor 0.4.5, rbs-inline 0.14.0, RBS 4.2.0 and Prism 1.9.0 over the
official shared project copied in `test/fixtures/rigor_lens/project`.
Types are producer output, not hand-authored expectations. The adapter adds
public-declaration bindings; it does not alter type display strings.

See `test/fixtures/rigor_lens/README.md` for upstream commit and attribution.

It exercises constant value slots, alias sites and the public singleton member of a module function. Its type strings are unchanged producer output. Older producer snapshots are not retained.
